title: Dark factory sound review — revised motors, cooling, lights and cameras

clips.label: Car sled arriving
clips.text: Isolated automotive factory body carriage arriving on steel rails. Electric drive rises into a smooth fast roll, restrained wheel chatter and heavy mechanical mass, then decelerates with a short servo whine and firm cushioned docking clunk. Close clean industrial sound, dry recording, no voices, no music, no alarms.

clips.label: Robot arm — soft stepper travel
clips.text: Isolated electric stepper motors smoothly moving a robotic arm. Soft rounded harmonic whirrs gently rise and fall with acceleration and braking, a delicate stepped singing tone from several joints moving together, very restrained mechanical texture, clean controlled stop. Muted, smooth and quiet. No harsh gearbox, no grinding, no impacts, no loud industrial roar, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Soft electric stepper motor tones and gentler travel level.

clips.label: Robot arm — soft precision stepping
clips.text: Seamless loop of soft electric stepper motor precision positioning. Gentle muted harmonic tones, delicate short stepped whirrs and tiny pitch changes from slow corrective robotic joint movements. Intimate quiet smooth electric texture, restrained and rounded, no grinding gearbox, no harsh buzzing, no rattles or impacts, no air hiss, no background ambience, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Quiet fine stepper movements, matching the new travel timbre.

clips.label: Pinch welder closing
clips.text: Single industrial resistance spot welding gun closing its electrode jaws: short electric actuator whirr, compact heavy metallic contact click, brief pressure creak and solid clamp. Close dry isolated mechanical sound. No arc yet, no explosion, no hammering sequence, no voices, no music.

clips.label: Spot welding bursts and expulsion
clips.text: Automotive resistance spot welding, three distinct short electrical weld pulses. Each has a tight transformer buzz and sharp crackling metal expulsion with tiny hot sparks sizzling and scattering onto steel. Mechanical and energetic but brief, not a continuous MIG arc, no huge explosions, no voices, no music, close isolated recording.

clips.label: Inspection capture cue
clips.text: A single very short understated synthetic camera capture cue: crisp soft shutter-like double tick with a tiny electronic click, premium industrial inspection interface, clean dry sound, no ringing notification melody, no voice, no music, no ambience. Artificial UI cue rather than a large photographic mirror mechanism.

clips.label: Panel suction pickup
clips.text: Isolated vacuum gripper picking up a thin stamped automotive steel panel. Soft rubber suction cups settle with a muted contact, a brief vacuum intake hiss, small valve click, then a slight sheet metal flex and rattle as it lifts. Controlled industrial machinery, close dry recording, no voices, no music.

clips.label: Panel seating on frame
clips.text: Thin stamped automotive steel panel lowered carefully onto its matching metal mounting frame. A light hollow sheet-metal settling clack followed by two soft contact ticks and slight damped flex, cushioned by sealant. Precise controlled placement, not dropping scrap metal. Close dry isolated recording, no voices, no music.

clips.label: Sealant dispensing
clips.text: Seamless steady loop of an industrial robotic sealant dispenser extruding a thick adhesive bead. Restrained electric metering pump whirr, fine pneumatic hiss and subtle viscous extrusion texture, close detailed dry sound, smooth and consistent. No water splashing, no spray painting, no voices, no music, no ambience.

clips.label: Cooling sheet metal — buckling and pops
clips.text: Thin stamped automotive sheet steel cooling and contracting after welding. Several irregular hollow metallic oil-canning pops and low boing-like panel buckles, short dry creaks and elastic sheet-metal flex, strongest at first then fewer softer settling pops. Real broad steel panel changing tension, not crumpling foil. Isolated close recording, no frying sizzle, no water or steam, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Sheet steel flexing, oil-canning and buckling as it cools.

clips.label: Fluorescent tubes — flicker then stable
clips.text: A bank of old fluorescent tubes starting in a factory. Contactor clack, then staggered repeated starter ticks, fluttering electrical buzz and sputtering ballast chatter as several tubes flicker on and off unevenly for four seconds. Flickering gradually stops, all tubes strike and settle into a faint smooth steady ballast hum for the last two seconds. No power explosion, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Staggered tube starter chatter and flickering buzz settle into stable light.

clips.label: NIR — vintage camera flash charging
clips.text: One vintage portable photographic flash charging its large capacitor. A tiny switch click, coarse pulsing inverter whine climbs in pitch into a smooth thin sustained high electrical charging tone, then tapers to silence when charged. Recognizable old camera flash power supply, dense and analog, dry close detail. No flash discharge, no ready beep, no sci-fi chirp, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Old portable camera flash capacitor charging; rising electrical whine.

clips.label: Thermal — heavy flash capacitor charging
clips.text: An old heavy portable camera flash recharging a large capacitor. Soft switch click, low raspy pulsing electronic oscillator develops into a rising strained high-pitched charging whine, slowing and softening into silence once full. Dense analog inverter character, slightly longer and heavier than a small flash. Dry close sound, no flash bang, no ready beep, no musical UI melody, no voices.
clips.revision_note: A slower heavier capacitor charge, distinct from the NIR cue.

clips.label: Factory room ambience
clips.text: Seamless room tone loop inside a large automated automotive factory at night. Deep restrained ventilation rumble, distant low machinery hum, spacious natural industrial reflections, a few very faint remote mechanical textures. Mostly steady and unobtrusive, no distinct foreground actions, no voices, no footsteps, no music, no alarms.

clips.label: Extraction — soft heavy industrial fans
clips.text: Seamless loop of large heavy industrial ventilation fans turning slowly. Soft deep rounded motor hum, low broad blade wash and faint slow rotor modulation, steady unhurried weight, smooth restrained bass, minimal upper frequency air noise. Subtle distant fan bed for a quiet automated factory. No shrill suction whistle, no harsh hiss, no rattling, no startup, no music or voices.
clips.revision_note: Large slow heavy fans: soft low rotor wash, much quieter in the mix.

clips.label: Control cabinet electronics
clips.text: Seamless quiet close loop of a powered industrial robot control cabinet: subtle small cooling fans, low transformer hum and faint electrical switching texture. Stable and unobtrusive, dry isolated detail for layering, no alarm beeps, no clicks, no coil scream, no voices, no music, no room ambience.

clips.label: Panel gripper releasing
clips.text: Vacuum panel gripper disengaging from a fixed steel panel: small pneumatic solenoid click, gentle brief pressure-release hiss and four soft rubber suction cup pops close together, then silence. Restrained clean industrial detail, dry close recording, no metal drop, no voices, no music.

clips.label: Car sled departing
clips.text: Automotive factory body carriage departing on steel rails. A restrained drive engagement clunk, rising electric traction motor whine and accelerating steel wheel roll, mechanical rumble receding into the distance. Smooth heavy controlled industrial movement, no train horn, no voices, no music, no background factory.
